packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 removed tsconfig 'baseUrl', which @docusaurus/tsconfig still sets, so `npm run typecheck` fails. Unhold once Docusaurus ships a TS7-compatible tsconfig.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Most security alerts here are transitive dependencies of the docs site, which no package.json bump reaches. A weekly lockfile refresh pulls their fixed versions within the existing ranges.
